headline: Coal SPV drives the beat, Kleros case awaits outcome

highlights: The PAT beat was primarily driven by (1) Coal SPV profitability improving to USD9/t versus ~USD6/t QoQ and USD2/t YoY, benefiting from higher imported coal prices, and (2) standalone PAT growth of 63% YoY, supported by Mundra operations and higher DSM revenues.
Management reiterated its FY27 renewable capacity addition target of 2.5 GW, of which 25% was achieved in 1HFY27.
Tata Power remains on track to achieve its FY27 capex guidance of INR250bn, having incurred INR100bn in 1HFY27.
Regarding the Kleros dispute, management remains confident of a favourable outcome.

It continues to strengthen its storage portfolio, with the 1,000 MW Bhivpuri PSP targeted for H1CY29 and the newly approved 1,800 MW Shirota PSP targeted for CY31.
We retain ACCUMULATE with a TP of INR414, implying 11x 1HFY29E EV/EBITDA.
watch: The outcome of the Kleros dispute remains the key stock catalyst, given that Tata Power has not recognised any provision against the USD490mn claim (excluding interest).
